claim: Explicit MMU interrupt initialization may remove the first tiler-heap job timeout seen after G7 probe; hardware causality is unproven.
oracle: After a fresh Linux boot and a single G15 probe, the first geometry readback passes 768 pixels with no scheduler timeout or recovery reset; repeated draws and desktop stay usable.

user_journey.scenario: User boots Omarchy and opens Files or an Agent terminal without a first-launch freeze. A failed experiment restores the existing recovery baseline; USB loss must not leave a permanent startup change. Manual edits are preserved.
user_journey.expected: Cold first application renders; user can touch and type; failures remain visible. Physical acceptance and reconnect are required before integration.

invariants: Exact upstream 8a597d099b8b2f25df655cbe8e30765013784fed behavior: clear pending MMU IRQ then unmask, only after IRQ request succeeds.
Existing device init already initializes AS lock/list before MMU init.
Reset retains the same two writes through the shared helper.
No PM reference-count, voltage, frequency, DT, firmware or boot-image changes.
G7 source is preserved; G15 builds in its own external-module directory.
gitnexus: External kernel is outside this workspace graph; UNKNOWN coverage replaced by direct device_init -> mmu_init -> IRQ handler and reset source tracing.
ast: Compile extracted actual init/fini/helper C against failure-injected IRQ/MMIO stubs; also compile the full module.

unit.red: Original G7 init must fail the successful-probe MMIO assertion.
unit.green: Patched actual C passes IRQ lookup failure, IRQ request failure, successful probe clear-before-mask, teardown mask-zero and repeated init/fini.
cases: negative IRQ returns unchanged and no request/MMIO
request failure returns unchanged and no MMIO

faults: 120-second watchdog and host capture before driver loading
stop on timeout, MMU fault storm or lost USB
no GUI startup persistence before fresh boot pass
evidence: G15 exact module loaded after fresh backup and G1/G9 power gates.
First geometry0.138s; subsequent0.032/0.032s; each768pixels; MMU IRQ0->3; no timeout since bind.
G10 and G12 first geometry timeout followed by successful post-reset draw.
G7 mmu_init registers IRQ but does not enable MMU interrupts; reset enables them.
Upstream exact MMU-init fix and related PM commit describe the same failure mechanism.
limitations: Offline tests cannot prove IRQ delivery, first-shader success, touchscreen smoothness or battery stability.
Autosuspend remains outside this experiment because platform power ownership is incomplete.
Cellular, Wi-Fi, camera and general app stability remain separate incomplete goals.
Private ADB discovery and B selection restored access; one cold boot passed, persistent boot and physical UI remain pending.
exit_gate: Offline RED/GREEN plus warning-free exact-kernel build permit a watchdog-guarded trial only. Installation/boot integration requires real cold first-draw and recovery tests plus physical UI acceptance.
